# AIS-HUM-02

**Are users told when they deal with AI or receive generated content?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | HUM: People and obligations |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.ai.disclosure` |

## Rule

Every generative ai facet whose output reaches an actor has disclosure.
